titleBody: Type a name or keep the suggestion.
openBody: Tap the card of the new combat.
addUnitBody: Tap the tile to add a unit.
unitNameBody: A hero’s name or an enemy type.
unitSaveTitle: Put the unit in the combat
rollBody: A d20 roll sets the initiative.
startBody: Tap to begin the first round.
hpApplyBody: Type a number and tap “Damage” or “Heal”.
linkBody: Show the QR code or copy the link to your chat.
playerHeroBody: Tick yours. A lock means the hero is taken.
playerIntroBody: This is the turn order. The DM will start the combat soon.
playerIntroActiveBody: This is the turn order. Your turn will light up.
playerRollBody: Roll a d20 or enter your result with − and +.
playerHpBody: Took damage or healing? Tap your HP.
playerHpApplyBody: Type a number and tap “Damage” or “Heal”.
playerExpandBody: Tap your hero’s name to open conditions and defenses.
playerMenuBody: Release your hero or leave the combat here.
playerTurnBody: The strip on top tells you when it’s your turn or you’re next.
